svg.title: Thyroid nodule workup: TSH first (low goes to a radioactive iodine scan), then ultrasound and TI-RADS size cut-offs for fine needle aspiration, then the Bethesda category sorts the nodule into benign, indeterminate follicular neoplasm, or papillary, medullary or anaplastic cancer; each column gives clues, next steps and treatment in order

svg.text: Thyroid nodule: which one earns a NEEDLE, and which result earns SURGERY?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: common: 0.1% a year, 10% lifetime · most are benign · not always thyroid: parathyroid, lymph node, skin, soft tissue

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: cancer risk: child · male · first-degree family history · neck radiation · firm or fixed · suspicious nodes

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: URGENT: rapid growth · stridor · progressive dysphagia · large, fixed, firm mass

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 · Thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) FIRST: is it LOW?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: LOW → radioactive iodine (RAI) scan: HOT = benign (see the THYROID FUNCTION chart) · COLD → ultrasound like the rest

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Normal or high TSH: work up in order

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 · Ultrasound + TI-RADS (Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System): fine needle aspiration (FNA) if TR5 ≥ 1 cm · TR4 ≥ 1.5 cm · TR3 ≥ 2.5 cm

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • smaller: repeat ultrasound for up to 5 years, stop if stable · TR1–2: nothing

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 · FNA: the Bethesda category picks the column ↓ · never a core or open biopsy for a nodule (seeding, bleeding)

svg.text: established or suspected cancer > 1 cm: hemithyroidectomy if low risk, total if high · node dissection if nodes

svg.text: • ultrasound 6–12 months after, then periodically: the remaining lobe + neck nodes

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • biopsy a suspicious node > 8–10 mm in its smallest dimension

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • pathology report sets stage, prognosis, more surgery, RAI: type, size, focality, capsule,

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: lymphatic + vessel invasion, extension, nodes, margins

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Not a neoplasm: hyperplasia or inflammation (no atypia)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • multinodular goitre: follicles of DIFFERENT function · sporadic or iodine-deficient

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Graves: 1%, F:M 8:1 · TSH-receptor antibodies → diffuse hyperplasia, papillary infoldings

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Hashimoto: 1–2%, F:M 4:1 · lymphocytes, HURTHLE cells (pink cytoplasm), fibrosis ·

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: early leak → thyrotoxic, later small fibrotic gland
